pairs.question: Cur lamenta rigant genas madentes, cur uestri memor ut fiam rogatis?
pairs.derivation: Fructuosus poses two rhetorical questions to the weeping bystanders (lines 84-85) and answers them himself in line 86. Question span starts at 'Cur' (84) through 'rogatis?' (85), keeping both interrogatives contiguous; capitalization of 'Cur' is source-initial, terminal '?' normalized. Answer is the single full sentence that follows, line 86, capitalized 'Cunctis' and terminal '.' normalized; nothing precedes or follows within the utterance that needs cutting.
